issues.text: Section 11 row 8 says «VB-2 and VB-3 keep their assertions». VB-3 kept every twin and every expectation, but its helper `titleLine` found the title line of the open index.html with /^ *<title>…/, and the page that F6 built has `<title data-t="closed_test">` (design 4.3); with the old pattern VB-3 stopped with «a page without a title line» as soon as the awaited run reached the twin «the open page with its title swapped». The pattern now accepts attributes on the title tag (row 8's own change, not a weaker expectation). The design's measurement of row 8 (F39) was taken on a sketch whose index.html had a plain title tag.

The twelve damaged copies of IB-2 are one more than the design's eleven: «a second .d.ts beside a plain .js that is not listed» was added beside «a .d.ts beside a .js that app/vendored.json does not list» (the first has no .js twin of the same name in the list at all; the second has a .js of its own that is plain but unlisted) — M84 and M86 are caught by both. CP-2's FORMS list holds the design's 22 forms plus 17 variants, GREEN the design's 16 twins plus 9 border twins; ci-workflow adds the order rule `e2e order` (npm ci before npm run test:e2e, as 4.13 lists them) and the checks of the e2e job's name of the first step; all of them only widen what is red.

Counts after T1: unit 47 (46 + CP-3), int 36, e2e 0 (the folder and NPM-7 come at T4), pg 2 unchanged. NPM-5's title still says 10 int files and node-main's NM-5 14 unit files: they change in T3 and T2 with their lists (rows 2 and 3), not here. The helper browser.js is not covered by a test of its own (decisions/0124 O10); its first use is T4's landing and stage tests; its failure with no Chrome on the machine is the message of playwright-core, never a skip. Chrome on the GitHub runner is measured by TEST-RUNNER (decisions/0124 O7).
No edit of the code was needed: no test of this sub-step caught an error of the code, and none departs from the design except what I1 and I2 name.
